'''Ultana Anya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] newscaster who worked at the [[Coruscant News Desk]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Anya relayed news about a live press conference held by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], regarding another attack by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Malevolence/Legends|mysterious new weapon]].
